qa.title: Q1426 (Aug. 8, 2025)
qa.question: I summon a Golden Beast Tamer and Nitro Juggler with Silver Thorn Dragon Tamer, Luquier's Fanfare ability. If I banish a Pale Moon follower that costs 2 or less with Nitro Juggler's Fanfare ability, can I summon it with Golden Beast Tamer's Fanfare ability?

Yes. Since Golden Beast Tamer's Fanfare ability and Nitro Juggler's Fanfare ability trigger and become pending at the same time, you may resolve them in any order.

qa.question: When attacking using a follower with Twin Drive, if I reveal a Trigger with the first drive check, do I resolve the Trigger before or after performing the second drive check?
qa.answer: You resolve the Trigger first.
